evidence: Explicit Claude co-author trailer and Claude Code session reference in commit 0a68fabbad5e4c4572fcd91066f050250da3f1b3: https://github.com/sidick/volamos/commit/0a68fabbad5e4c4572fcd91066f050250da3f1b3

notes: Wine-style host runtime for classic AmigaOS m68k command-line tools: interprets guest instructions (optional m68k-crate trace JIT) and reimplements OS library calls in Rust. No Kickstart ROM is needed for normal use. It is generic development/analysis tooling, not a native reconstruction of a specific game; graphics, custom chips, Workbench GUI and games are explicitly out of scope. Linux/macOS build and guest execution are corroborated by current CI logs; published Windows x86-64 binaries compile but Windows/Wine runtime remains unverified. Interpreter/JIT parity covers six fixtures; comparison with vamos includes three documented known divergences, so it is not universal compatibility proof. The math-library shims now return comparison/test results in both D0 and 68k condition codes, matching the documented ROM calling behavior needed by SAS/C's scmieee.lib; before the fix, SAS/C double comparisons appeared equal and exp() overflow checks returned HUGE_VAL. Evidence: https://github.com/sidick/volamos/commit/de321627fd5f1c16ca6cc76020222d7f3c18d564 exec.library SetFunction now installs executable guest JMP entries, returns a synthesized callable stub for the previous host-backed handler, supports hook chaining and restoration, and is covered by an end-to-end guest test. The patch is deliberately limited to one guest invocation and does not emulate AmigaOS-wide persistent hooks. Evidence: https://github.com/sidick/volamos/commit/018fd8f047d27fa3f85948b1595f44acf3f6f596 v0.10 incorporates non-AUTOINIT disk-library loading and the MakeLibrary/AddLibrary/InitStruct/MakeFunctions exec paths. Current main also adds opt-in CLI handling for UAE's formatted debug port at $BFFF00 and Emu68's byte debug port at $DEADBEEF, routing guest diagnostics to stderr without claiming broader GUI/custom-chip emulation. Evidence: https://github.com/sidick/volamos/releases/tag/v0.10 https://github.com/sidick/volamos/commit/2ee28f5f2759a9ea5096ba7f0068c4ec4cf94011 https://github.com/sidick/volamos/commit/359f762476c061b3b487cdcaf1dc86acdc786dd9 https://github.com/sidick/volamos/commit/fcec136d6f7f416b89af11d6bb76f6c89c96a8f5 v0.11 publishes aarch64 Apple/Linux and x86-64 Windows/Linux archives. Current sanitizer work extends exec.library Allocate/Deallocate handling: allocations become uninitialized, frees become unaddressable/freed, and live MemChunk headers remain addressable to avoid false positives. It can catch guest use-after-free and optionally uninitialized reads, but deliberately has no redzones, so one-byte overruns remain outside the stated coverage. Upstream reports 1,109 workspace tests passing; real gcc/sc binary checks were not run and trap-level end-to-end tests substitute. The implementation commit explicitly credits Claude Sonnet 5.
